mentions.name: ESP32 CAN bus display
mentions.description: A DIY hardware project that decodes CAN bus data and displays real-time CAN bus readings on a 4-inch screen driven by an ESP32.
mentions.source_excerpt: Next to that I'm also very into CAN bus decoding these days (on the side) and building ESP32 with a screen to show the real CAN bus data on a 4" screen.
mentions.author: Byte1337
